issues: docs/module-map.md:34-35 (new text in 429e5e6) is wrong. It says the modules not named in item 5 'reach each other only at call time, binding nothing at load beyond what core/ publishes (NS.Constants, NS.L, NS.Perf, NS.NewBusTarget)'. But modules/FilterCompiler.lua:192 binds `local FV = NS.FilterViews` at file load, and AuraMaster.toc already marks that pair LOAD-BEARING ('FilterViews before FilterCompiler, which takes NS.FilterViews as a file-scope upvalue'). Item 5 of the load-order narrative never names the FilterViews/FilterCompiler pair, so the sentence this commit widened now states something false about a load-bearing pair. Fix: name FilterViews before FilterCompiler in item 5, or narrow the sentence.

The commit body says the toc-file-§5 re-read covered the whole TOC listing and found one mislabelled position (Container). That re-read is incomplete. Six other module files also bind NS.CONTAINER_TEMPLATE (defaults\Profile.lua) at file scope: modules/Style.lua:22, Style_Bars.lua:22, Style_Icons.lua:15, Style_Text.lua:54 (indexes `.text` at load, so it errors outright if Profile loads later), Anchors.lua:29 and Anchors_Attach.lua:16. Their TOC notes (AuraMaster.toc:98-111) name other symbols but not this one, so by the reasoning used for Container their notes do not name everything that resolves at load. This was optional added work (AuraMaster is not in the C05 cluster in 03_SPEC.md) and it is not a regression, but both the commit body and the new module-map sentence ('Container.lua ... is load-bearing too') present Container as the only modules-section dependency on the defaults template, and that is inaccurate.

Not a defect, recorded for the run record: the item's verify step for AM-A-05 (gh issue view 22 shows state:done) is unmet by design. The new test_loadorder case does pin the Container order and its note.
